walk.name: On foot
walk.sub: Inside the moat, in a morning
walk.hook: Everything the old city holds, including the spot the founder was killed on, within a square 1.6 km on a side.
walk.start: Wat Chiang Man, north-east quarter. Any red songthaew from anywhere in town, 30 ฿.
walk.finish: Chiang Mai Gate. The market is on from dusk.
walk.hours: Start at seven. Monks eat before eleven, so anything involving a tray happens in the first four hours.
kit: Water. More than you think.
Long trousers or a long skirt; shoulders covered. Two of these stops will turn you away otherwise and lend you a sarong at the third.
Shoes that come off fast. You will take them off eight times.
Small notes. Nothing here has change for a thousand.
A hat. There is no shade on Ratchadamnoen.

ride.name: By bicycle
ride.sub: The moat, the mountain's foot, and the city the river buried
ride.hook: The dead were kept outside the wall. On a bicycle you can reach all of it and be back by dark.
ride.start: Wat Ku Tao, north of the moat behind the stadium.
ride.hours: Out by six thirty. The last hour of this ride is the reason to do it, and it needs the light to go.
kit: A bike with gears. The Suthep Road side climbs.
Lights, front and back. You will finish after sunset and the canal roads are unlit.
Water and a second bottle.
Long trousers. Same rule as the walk, and it is also what keeps the sun off on a bike.
A lock. Leave the bike inside the wat wall, not on the street.
ride.note: Hire: 50–150 ฿ a day for a city bike from a shop on Moon Muang or Ratchaphakhinai; 300–600 ฿ for something with gears worth riding up Suthep. Prices seen September 2026; check them.
ride.band: Out at six thirty, back after dark

scoot.name: On a scooter
scoot.th: มอเตอร์ไซค์
scoot.sub: The whole valley, in a day, on two wheels
scoot.band: Everything outside the moat, before dark
scoot.hook: A scooter reaches the mountain, the giants' shrine and the buried capital in one day, which nothing else on this site does without a driver. It is also the way most people in Chiang Mai get anywhere.
scoot.start: Wherever you hired it, by seven. Doi Suthep is the stop that punishes a late start.
scoot.hours: Eleven stops. About 55 km on the clock once the mountain switchbacks are counted. Doi Suthep before nine, the mountain done by noon, the valley floor in the afternoon.
kit: *A helmet, worn.* It is the law, it is enforced on the moat road, and a checkpoint fine runs 500–1,000 ฿. The rental gives you one. Wear it up the mountain in particular.

*A licence that actually covers a motorcycle.* A home motorcycle licence plus an International Driving Permit with category A on it. A car-only IDP does not cover a scooter, and the checkpoints around the old city check the class rather than glancing at the booklet.
*Your insurance, read before you go.* Policies commonly exclude a rider who was not licensed for the machine. Find the clause in yours rather than finding it afterwards.
Long trousers and shoes. The same rule the wats want, and the same rule that decides how a slide at 30 km/h goes.
Photographs of the bike, all four sides, before you ride off. Scratch disputes at the return are the standard complaint.
About 60 ฿ of fuel. That is the whole day on a 125.
scoot.note: Hire: 200–350 ฿ a day for a 110–125 cc automatic, 600–1,200 ฿ for something bigger, quoted around the old city in September 2026. Leave a cash deposit rather than a passport. Check them, they move.

drive.name: With a driver
drive.sub: The mountain, the giants, and the buried capital — one day
drive.hook: Four of these are up a mountain or across a river and none of them are walkable. This is the day that needs a car and someone who knows the roads.
drive.start: Picked up wherever you are staying, seven a.m.
drive.hours: Doi Suthep is a car park between ten and four. Going first, at seven, is the whole reason to hire a driver rather than take a songthaew at ten.
kit: Cash for entries: about 100 ฿ a head across the day.
The same clothing rule. Doi Suthep enforces it at the gate.
Something warm for the top in the cool season. It is 1,050 m and it is not Chiang Mai weather up there.
Motion tolerance or a tablet. The Suthep road is switchbacks the whole way.
drive.band: Doi Suthep at seven, not at ten

drive-north.name: The second day north
drive-north.hook: Seventy-two kilometres north, a full day, and the only stop on this site outside the Chiang Mai valley.
drive-north.hours: The caves shut at five and the lamp guides go home before that.
kit: Shoes with grip. The unlit passages are wet limestone.
Cash for the guide, 200–300 ฿, paid at the mouth.
A torch of your own as well.
drive-north.band: A mountain with a city inside it
